about.beforeAfter: Make ideas tangible with before-and-after images
about.creatorsText: Local artists can suggest colour, light, art and new expressions for the city's spaces.
about.ctaText: Start by exploring what others have seen, or share your own vision.
about.findText: Discover streets, squares, parks and other places with potential.
about.howText: Stadslyft is built to make participation easy, whether you have a finished idea or simply see something that could be better.
about.intro: Stadslyft makes it easy to turn frustration into proposals. Residents and local artists can share ideas about our common places and make them visible, concrete and actionable.
about.localArtists: Invite local artists to contribute creative proposals
about.mattersText: Let votes and support make residents' priorities clear.
about.observation: A better city starts with an observation.
about.observationText: You do not have to be an urban planner. It is enough to care about a place and want to see it grow.
about.potentialText: Find places that deserve more life, safety and care.
about.signals: Create clear signals for future decisions
about.supportText: Vote, comment and build on ideas together.
about.title: The city belongs to everyone who lives in it.
about.visionText: Describe what could be better and show how the place could look.
about.whyText: An unsafe passage, an empty square or a grey concrete wall affects everyday life more than we may realize. Stadslyft brings local knowledge and creativity together where they belong: with the people who use these places and the local artists who can give them new life.
about.whyTitle: Small changes can make a big difference.
